name: Bollinger Band squeeze breakout (BandWidth near 6-month low)

entry_long: BB(20,2) bands narrow with BandWidth near the low end of its ~6-month range, then price closes/breaks above the upper band.
entry_short: Same squeeze condition, then price breaks below the lower band.
exit: Source gives no mechanical exit (neutral squeeze; suggests confirming with support/resistance and watching head-fake reversals). Define exit externally e.g. close back through the middle band.
